input_tokens.semantics: Observed message snapshots by message.id; categories kept separate; no billing equivalence

output_tokens.semantics: Observed message snapshots by message.id; categories kept separate; no billing equivalence

cache_read_input_tokens.semantics: Observed message snapshots by message.id; categories kept separate; no billing equivalence

cache_creation_input_tokens.semantics: Observed message snapshots by message.id; categories kept separate; no billing equivalence

elapsed_wall_ms.semantics: First observed SessionStart to observation; includes resume gaps

model_request_latency_ms.semantics: Hooks do not expose request start/end

api_query_duration_ms.semantics: Claude SDK query API duration; not per-request latency or thinking time

tool_execution_ms.semantics: Sum of identified host execution durations; may overlap, not a wall-time total

tool_bracket_union_ms.semantics: Union of paired hook receipt brackets; includes approval, hook and dispatch overhead

active_interval_union_ms.semantics: Supported hook/transcript observations do not establish execution interval boundaries

handoff_wait_ms.semantics: Stop-to-next-prompt wall gaps; may include automation and background activity

human_permission_stops.semantics: Approval candidates may be auto-approved; no confirmed UI episode identity

human_clarification_stops.semantics: Question/tool requests do not prove human yields

permission_notifications.semantics: Observed permission_prompt notifications, not episodes; delayed, repeatable, may target automated SDK callbacks

collector_work_ms.semantics: Collector work sample excludes final sample write and process startup
